notes.title: Patch 1.12.1
notes.notes:
In some cases it wasn't possible to unlock the 1% achievement. This problem is solved now.
If you had this problem and your "earned Money" stat got stuck, it should now trigger the achievement once you reach the 1 million $.

notes.title: Help for the helpless
notes.notes:
Greetings!

The first let's play has been made and I saw the first person, not involved in the project or playing the first game (formerly known as Afterlife), fail on their first day as a funeral home owner.
I have noticed, that some game mechanics, might not be as plausible to others, as they are to me (...obviously, because I made them).

For that very reason, I have deceided to implement more details into the ingame help for all those, who might find themselves overwhelmed on their first try (I take that as a compliment btw. ːsteamhappyː).

Should you be interested in watching the Let's Play, you can find it here:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rTFio5-7U7I

Go there, watch it, and tell the man to make more episodes!  ;)

notes.title: Where is Afterlife 2?
notes.notes:
You might ask yourself: "Why do I have a game called Undertaker's in my followed games? ...and where is this Afterlife 2 everybody is talking about?!"

Because I am very creative and thought the name Afterlife 2 is too simple, I've decided to change it.
The reason totally isn't, that there apparently was a game called Afterlife, made by Lucas Arts in 1996 (oops) that was an economy simulation (double oops).
Who could have known?
Well... I admit that I should have known... using the search engine of choice to simply google the name isn't that complicated is it?

The games are not really similiar but you know... 'Scrolls' and 'The Elder Scrolls' aren't either.

A lovely Steam moderator gave me a hint, that this might cause legal troubles (I know that is your job... but thanks for that ;) ).

The name is changed, the shopsite is changed, and I hope I have found every little piece of artwork and text that was in the game.



While you are waiting, here is a thing:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29188926/da14cc3a4e3e0178ea9044a98f6e698e1423de85.gif[/img]

No reason.

notes.title: So.. this is this Steam thingy..
notes.notes:
So we made it through Greenlight with a bunch of other games.
That's good.
Now we need to take care for the shopsite and implementation of Steam features. That's not so good.

I mean, it's no problem. It's not overly complicated. It's just time-intensive.
...and if you already sink your time in the coding, the drawing and the balancing... it seems there are not enough hours a day.

I am not whining (maybe a little), this is just a little notification for everyone, that work on the game continues.. and actually shows results.


While you are waiting, here is a picture of the Jobcenter
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29188926/275079a4e4daa6492a7788ce27857d2d98a8a688.png[/img]
..no reason..
